dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: Shh... Keep quiet. I'm still figuring this place out.

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: Seems like most people here only go to the Rag and Bone Shop to buy their bric a brac. I can't go prancing about with my wares setting up shop willy-nilly... Wouldn't be good to attract the wrong kind of attention from certain parties...
